title: Computation of the Fast-Meter Refund, Metering Service
content:
The **Metering Service** fast-meter refund is the amount defined in the clause below, computed from the company test result, the regular bills of the Electric Service Agreement at the premise, and the meter's metering charges.

## Clause

(1) The company test is the latest test result of the meter taken by the test method of the meter's type; its date is the company test date and its registration percentage is the company test's registration.

(2) The fast-meter refund covers whole regular bills of the service agreement: counting back from the company test date, the most recent regular bills whose billing period ended on or before that date, as many as the smaller of the billing months the fast-meter refund reaches back and the fast-meter refund limit, and no bill whose billing period ended after the company test date.

(3) The billing months the fast-meter refund reaches back are one half of the whole calendar months between the later of the meter's installation date and the test date of its latest within-tolerance result, and the company test date, rounded down to a whole month. The fast-meter refund limit is the meter type's refund limit.

(4) The charges the fast-meter refund corrects are the energy and Power Supply Cost Recovery charges of those bills, and the fast-meter error factor is the absolute value of one minus 100 divided by the company test's registration. No late payment charge is corrected and no interest is added, so the corrected late payment charges and the refund interest are each 0.00.

(5) The fast-meter refund is the corrected charges times the fast-meter error factor, rounded to the cent, plus the corrected late payment charges, plus the refund interest, plus every repeat test fee standing on the meter's metering charges, which the refund returns because the meter was in fact inaccurate. A fast-meter refund smaller than the meter type's adjustment threshold is recorded as 0.00.

Whole calendar months are counted from a day of one month to the same day of a later month.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| Installation date | 1 March 2022 |
| Latest within-tolerance result | 1 March 2023 |
| Company test | 20 March 2025, registration 103.00 |
| Meter type's refund limit and adjustment threshold | 12 months and 1.00 |
| Energy and Power Supply Cost Recovery charges of the 12 most recent regular bills ending on or before 20 March 2025 | 1,800.00 and 300.00 |
| Repeat test fees standing on the meter's metering charges | One fee of 45.00 |

- Later of installation and latest within-tolerance date: 1 March 2023. Whole calendar months to 20 March 2025: 24. One half: 12. The smaller of 12 and the 12-month limit: 12 bills.
- Corrected charges: 2,100.00. Error factor: the absolute value of one minus 100 divided by 103, that is 0.0291262.
- 2,100.00 times 0.0291262 is 61.17 after rounding to the cent.
- Refund: 61.17 plus 0.00 plus 0.00 plus 45.00, that is 106.17, which is not below 1.00.
